modules.module_title: Prepare for a relevant guiding activity

pcs.pc_description: plan physical logistics for the activity - transport, food/water, two-way radio, backup plans if the sky is cloudy, selection of location based on how much of the sky is blocked by landscape
Plan for medical assistance if needed, warmer color lights for navigation, transport or stay after the show is over at night.

Plan technical logistics for the activity - transport or access to telescope, power supply, star maps and other accessories to hand out to tourists, online or offline astronomy apps for the phone, chairs or stools for shorter people to access the eyepiece, etc
have an alternative program schedule on sky observation nights in case it gets cloudy.

modules.module_title: Provide and collect pre-trip information from guests and colleagues

pcs.pc_description: provide pre-activity details to guests (access to location, celestial objects that will be shown, expected temperature at night and appropriate clothing, time duration of the show, etc.)
collect basic health information (e.g. night blindness, issues with colder temperature, altitude etc.)

Define the script of your experience, the chronology of the important events and the primary ideas that you will transmit in each of them (for example, the landscape and history of the region you are in, facts about the Solar System, major astronomical discoveries, and so on).
Give clear route information, as well as maps and location details

modules.module_title: Plan for the physical movement of tourists among the telescopes

pcs.pc_description: Provide information on the nature and purpose of the astronomical facilities and equipment that will be used
Teach the group how to adjust the focus of each lens of the binoculars or how to adjust the eyepiece of the telescope

If the number of tourists is large, then plan where they will be standing, how they will access the telescopes and then move to let others see through them etc. since the event will be held in darkness
Arrange proper standing arrangements should be made so that they don’t fall or trip the telescope during the various instructions sets.

Scout out the area ahead of time to decide the exact locations to place the telescopes to avoid bright lights (or make arrangements to dim or shut them)

modules.module_title: Plan for photography of the sky

pcs.pc_description: • Send the participants advance information of what they can do if they have • (1) cellphone cameras and (2) DSLR cameras, and ask them to come prepared
Plan for which photographs you will guide them for, depending on the darkness of the sky, presence of the moon, etc. Come prepared with suitable accessories like adaptors etc.
